definitions.gloss: food expenses; food costs; food budget
definitions.explanation: The amount of money spent on food, whether for a household, individual, or organization. A common category in personal budgeting and household economics.

examples.japanese: {食費|しょくひ}を{節約|せつやく}する。
{今月|こんげつ}は{食費|しょくひ}が{高|たか}くなった。
examples.english: Food expenses were higher this month.

examples.japanese: {一人暮|ひとりぐ}らしを{始|はじ}めてから、{食費|しょくひ}を{月|つき}{三万円|さんまんえん}に{抑|おさ}えるようにしている。
examples.english: Since I started living alone, I've been trying to keep my food budget under 30,000 yen a month.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common household expense categories. Often discussed alongside other expense types like {家賃|やちん} (rent), {光熱費|こうねつひ} (utility bills), and {交通費|こうつうひ} (transportation costs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食費|しょくひ}を{節約|せつやく}する (to save on food expenses)
- {食費|しょくひ}を{抑|おさ}える (to keep food costs down)
- {月|つき}の{食費|しょくひ} (monthly food expenses)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生活費|せいかつひ}: living expenses — the broader category that includes food, housing, and other costs
- {外食費|がいしょくひ}: dining-out expenses — money spent specifically on eating out
